title: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement Clause on Late Fees and the Second Late Fee
content:
### Clause 1 — When a late fee arises
A late fee is assessed once for a billing period of a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement when any part of that period's rent is still unpaid after the grace period. The late fee may be posted only when the handling date is later than the rent due date of the unpaid billing period plus the class's grace period days. Grace days are counted as calendar days starting the day after the due date, so a payment received on the last grace day is on time.

### Clause 2 — Amount of the late fee (former wording)
This former amount clause is no longer in force: "The late fee is the greater of the class's flat late-fee floor and the class's late-fee percentage times the monthly rent, rounded to the cent, and never more than the class's late-fee ceiling." This clause has been superseded by the current late-fee basis and is not used to figure a late fee.

### Clause 3 — Second late fee
When the period's rent is still unpaid the class's second-late-fee number of calendar days after its due date, a second late fee of the class's second late-fee amount is posted for the same period; no further late fees accrue on that period.

### Clause 4 — Status, limits and errors
A late fee is assessed only while the rental is in active, delinquent, lien noticed, auction scheduled or moving out status. Each billing period carries at most one late fee and one second late fee. A period whose rent is fully paid on or before the last grace day is never charged a late fee, and a late fee posted against such a period is a billing error. The first late fee of a cycle moves an active rental to delinquent, with its delinquency date set to that period's due date.

## The grace boundary (hypothetical class with a 5-day grace period, rent due 1 May)

| Date | Day after due date | Rent paid in full that day | Late fee may be posted that day if rent still unpaid |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 May | due date | on time | no |
| 6 May | day 5, the last grace day | on time | no |
| 7 May | day 6 | — | yes, the handling date is later than due date plus 5 days |

The comparison is strict: on the last grace day itself the late fee may not yet be posted.

## Second late fee boundary (hypothetical class setting day 15)

For rent due on 1 May and still unpaid, the second late fee is posted when the rent is still unpaid on 16 May, day 15 after the due date. A period carrying both fees accrues no third.

## Status check

| Rental status | Late fee may be assessed |
|---|---|
| active, delinquent, lien noticed, auction scheduled, moving out | yes |

superseded_clauses: The late fee is the greater of late_fee_flat_usd and late_fee_pct_of_rent times the monthly rent, rounded to the cent, and never more than late_fee_max_usd.
